# react-starter-template

Minimal React + TypeScript + Tailwind starter. Import into v0.dev to scaffold quickly.

## Stack

- React 18 + Vite
- TypeScript strict
- Tailwind CSS v3
- ESLint + Prettier

## Quick start

```bash
npm install && npm run dev
```
